name: Item Expire Convert
description: When an item with a duration (item_template.Duration > 0) expires, it is replaced with the item given here instead of simply being deleted. Loaded by ObjectMgr::LoadItemExpireConverts; there is no reload command.

fields.name: Item
fields.help: The expiring item (must have a Duration in item_template).

fields.name: Converted Item
fields.help: The item the player receives when the original expires.

fields.name: Target Item
fields.help: Open the item it converts into.
